notes: A picture this phone cannot keep up with now steps down to a size it can, instead of staying on the one showing a few frames a second.
The step back stops the moment a smaller size shows fewer frames than the one above it, so a phone that is slow everywhere is not reloaded down the whole list.
A size given up for the rate is no longer marked in the size list as one that did not play here - it played, just not at speed.
